Name: Vanilla Refreshed - Bachelors
Author: TariVendice
Description:
Vanilla Refreshed Bachelors (and Bachelorettes) is my first mod for Stardew Valley. It retouches the dateable vanilla characters while still keeping what makes them the characters we love.

[list]
[*][b]Alex[/b] - A recolor of his jacket and neater hair, because we know Evelyn wouldn't let him out like that.
[*][b]Elliott[/b] - New face! Now Elliott will look you in the eye instead of giving you the constant side-eye. Also configurable to give him a haircut if you want. I've given him a red henley because it's way easier to get the sand out of than a three-piece suit.
[*][b]Harvey[/b] - I dressed the good doctor down a bit while keeping him professional. Also, he's configurable to shave his mustache.
[*][b]Sam[/b] - I gave him a haircut so he (un)fortunately doesn't go Super Saiyan anymore. He also has two jackets to choose from: classic denim and army green (maybe an old one of Kent's).
[*][b]Sebastian[/b] - Seb also gets a haircut and a darker hoodie. He has options for dark hair and a biker jacket.
[*][b]Shane[/b] - The Joja hoodie has been patched up and no longer has holes in it. He also has an optional black hoodie for when you complete the community center or if he just needs a break from all things Joja.
[/list]
All characters have also been given slight (and not-so-slight) tweaks to their faces/necks to give them a cleaner look. Beach portraits are also included.

[b]Sprites Included (as of 12/7/23):[/b]
- Sam
- more to come!

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
[*]Download the main file and unzip it.
[*]Move the folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[*]That's it!
[/list]

[b]Possible Future Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]matching sprites
[*]winter sprites (post 1.6 release)
[/list]
